title: Vizing's theorem and equitable edge colourings
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Vizing's theorem: every finite simple graph G has a proper edge colouring with Δ(G) + 1 colours, stated with Mathlib's line graph (G.lineGraph is (Δ(G) + 1)-colourable, hence χ'(G) ≤ Δ(G) + 1), proved with fans and Kempe chain exchanges.
